C.name: Predictive Coding（預測編碼）
C.responsibility: Prediction, observation, prediction-error measurement, uncertainty calibration and evidence-based model updates.

E.name: Deep Research（深度研究）
E.responsibility: Multi-source research, source provenance and quality, corroboration, counter-evidence, cited synthesis and cross-track research support.

F.name: Cyber Security & Defense
F.responsibility: Cross-track threat modeling, security controls, adversarial validation, vulnerability response and incident readiness.

G.name: Release, QA & Integration
G.responsibility: 跨線整合順序、相容性矩陣、回歸測試、發布關卡、精確 SHA 證據與回滾準備。

H.name: Observability, Telemetry & Cost/Quota Governance
H.responsibility: Queue／Runner 健康、任務耗時、失敗分類、成本來源、配額與安全暫停告警。

I.name: Ecosystem, Connectors & Workflow Automation
I.responsibility: 外部 API、Webhook、通知、資料同步、冪等處理與防重播工作流。

J.name: Self-Healing, Chaos & Continuity
J.responsibility: 有限重試、熔斷、安全降級、檢查點、備份還原及受控故障演練。

K.name: Knowledge Base, Docs & Governance Playbooks
K.responsibility: 架構紀錄、線別責任、操作手冊、交接模板、決策紀錄與故障排查。

L.name: Multi-Node, Federation & Edge/Cluster Coordination
L.responsibility: 未來自願加入節點的身分、能力排程、租約 fencing、健康檢查與跨節點協調。

M.name: Compliance, Policy Audit & Risk Governance
M.responsibility: 可稽核事件、政策證據、風險登錄、限時例外及資料保留控制。

N.name: Productization, Analytics & Growth/Ecosystem Ops
N.responsibility: 隱私友善的產品指標、採用與品質分析、回饋循環、新手導引及生態營運。

O.name: Lifecycle, Deprecation & Legacy Retirement
O.responsibility: 棄用清單、遷移窗口、相容性契約、移除核准及舊系統維護成本降低。

P.name: Governance, Ethics & Trust/Policy Evolution
P.responsibility: 自主權限分級、人類核准門檻、信任原則、政策演進及跨線優先級仲裁。

policy: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; every material change increments at least PATCH; breaking architecture increments MAJOR; additive capability increments MINOR. Each A–P track has independent ownership, version, roadmap, tests and acceptance evidence. Cross-track changes require explicit receiving-owner review and compatibility evidence. Planned tracks do not imply shipped capability.
